title: Joining the band: Greyhound bus, Eugene and San Francisco fog
summary: Band was heading up the coast to Seattle; Monk alone in San Francisco felt afraid in the fog.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Where was the band playing when you joined them?

When I joined the band, they were off. They had finished somewhere in California and they had a couple days in San Francisco and then they drove up the coast. And as they drove up the coast they was making one-nighters, up to Seattle. That's where the band was headed, to Seattle.
Well, the first night you ever played with them, where were they?
They were in Oregon; I think it was Eugene, Oregon.

Bus. Everything was bus, yeah. A Greyhound bus. When I got to San Francisco, I got to San Francisco that night. I got there early that evening and that night...to think I was in San Francisco! I just couldn't imagine...Here's things you always hear how it is or see in the movies, or whatever. But to really be in San Francisco. I wished I...I wished some of my friends or my brother, or somebody I could go talk to and share this, seeing San Francisco for the first time.

That night when I came out of the hotel the fog was down. I never saw fog like that before. But I knew fog, San Francisco and fog go together. And here I was in San Francisco in the fog. Felt just like I could hear bells going off. And I remember I walked to the corner and I was afraid to go any further, really literally afraid to go any further because I couldn't look back and see the hotel, and I didn't want to get too far...
